**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in HGNC:53924 that are exclusively associated with only one of the two diseases, or the discovery of distinct causal genes for each disease with no functional overlap, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: A common variant (AF > 0.1%) in HGNC:53924 associated with either MONDO:0011327 or oculopharyngodistal myopathy 3.)_
